fullDescription: A sophisticated historical-editorial mobile UI style featuring a warm, parchment-inspired palette and minimalist boutique elements. Suitable for gamified productivity apps, luxury e-commerce, RPG inventories, or archival tools. It utilizes a layered approach with an edge-to-edge background in #EDE7D8 and a soft-edged paper sheet in #FBF8F1. The typography pairs a high-contrast serif for headings with a clean geometric sans for UI labels. Key features include ultra-thin 1px borders, gold-toned accents (#A5812F), and a unique asymmetrical quote bubble for mascot-led interactions.
prompt:
## Resumo
A minimalist historical-themed mobile interface that mimics the look of high-quality parchment and antique stationery. It features large, editorial serif headings, thin-lined UI components, and a specific 'paper sheet' layout that slides over a warm beige background.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a warm, historical-minimalist aesthetic. Use a primary background of #EDE7D8. Overlay this with a 'paper sheet' container in #FBF8F1 featuring a 40px top-border radius. Typography: Headings in 'Crimson Pro' or 'Playfair Display' (Bold, 60px, #3D352E); Body and UI labels in 'Manrope' (400-700 weight, #3D352E). Accent color: #A5812F (used for borders, active states, and icons). Buttons must be transparent with a 1px solid border (#A5812F) and 4px corner radius. Micro-interactions: Use 0.2s cubic-bezier ease-out for hover and active scale effects. Icons should be thin-line style (Lucide/Linear style) in #A5812F or #8C8276.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Area
Top padding of 48px, horizontal padding of 24px. Top-aligned metadata row using 11px uppercase tracking-widest text (#8C8276). A settings icon (24px) aligned to the right. A massive 60px Serif H1 title followed by a 16px medium-weight subtitle in #8C8276. The header sits directly on the #EDE7D8 background.

### Main Paper Content
A container with background #FBF8F1 and top-rounded corners (40px). Vertical padding starts at 40px. This area houses all primary functional content like lists and interaction bubbles. The shadow should be subtle: 0px -4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.03).

### Shop Inventory List
Vertical list of items separated by 1px solid lines (#E5DFD0). Each row has 20px top/bottom padding. Layout: Left side contains a 40px square rounded icon box (#F4F0E6) and text block (14px Bold Uppercase title, 12px muted subtitle). Right side contains the minimalist price button.

### Bottom Navigation Bar
Fixed bar with background #FBF8F1, height approx 80px. 1px top border (#E5DFD0). Five items distributed evenly. Active state: color #A5812F with a 2px horizontal indicator bar positioned 16px above the icon. Text labels: 11px uppercase, 0.05em letter spacing, centered under 24px icons.

### Floating Action Button
A 56x56 circular button in #A5812F. Centered white icon (24px). Positioned 24px from the right and 96px from the bottom. Includes a standard elevation shadow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Minimalist Price Button — A transparent, bordered button for transactional actions.
Border: 1px solid #A5812F. Padding: 4px 10px. Radius: 4px. Text: 15px Bold #A5812F. Includes a small 14px icon trailing the text with a 4px gap. Background is transparent, changing to rgba(165, 129, 47, 0.05) on hover.

### Character Quote Bubble — An asymmetrical speech bubble for mascot hints or quotes.
Background: #F4F0E6. Padding: 12px 16px. Border Radius: 20px 20px 20px 0px (bottom-left corner is sharp). Text: 14px Italic #3D352E with leading-relaxed. Paired with a 48px circular avatar to the left.

## Notas Especiais
MUST NOT use gradients, glossy textures, or vibrant yellows. MUST keep all border widths to exactly 1px for a delicate, 'ink-on-paper' feel. MUST use #F4F0E6 for secondary container backgrounds to maintain low-contrast warmth. The active tab must have a top-aligned bar indicator, not a background highlight.

style.description: The style essence is 'Modern Archive'—warm, tactile, and legible. It avoids gradients and shadows in favor of 1px borders and flat color blocks. Typography uses 'Crimson Pro' (Serif) for character and 'Manrope' (Sans) for functional data. The color palette is strictly limited to cream, beige, and bronze-gold.
